title: fragaria vesca f. roseiflora
intro: Fragaria vesca f. roseiflora, commonly known as the Woodland Strawberry, is a subspecies of the strawberry plant. It is a small perennial plant native to Europe and Asia, known for its sweet and fragrant fruits. The health benefits of Fragaria vesca f. roseiflora include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, among others, which may contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
